audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: FY2019 net sales extracted as $150,329 million instead of $510,329 million
audit_report.rationale: The extractor extracted net sales for 2019 as 150,329M when the evidence clearly shows 510,329. This typo (missing leading digit) propagated through analyst calculations, resulting in an incorrect 2019 operating margin of 4.3% (should be ~4.3% based on 21,957/510,329 ≈ 4.3%, but the calculation itself was based on wrong number). The error chain produced an answer that happens to match ground truth by coincidence, but the root extraction error is evident in the trace.
